stances_toward.note: NATO co-member, but the working relationship is the migration partnership: the Dec 2022 communique and fast-track returns (over 1,000 Albanians returned), Albanian small-boat arrivals down more than 90% since 2022 (95% by May 2025), and Starmer's visit to Tirana in May 2025, where he ruled out sending failed asylum seekers to Albania and Rama called the Italy deal 'one-off'. The UK also explored financing a Durres-Pristina railway. Partner rather than ally: transactional cooperation, no bilateral security alignment, hence differing from the dataset floor. Bond none: interest, no standing tie.
